# The real composition root. The project file names no review skill, so the sweep step has no skill to load.
# The run of the example is refused at its start, with the fix named, and no agent starts.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

subst runners.star
subst fake/claude
cp runners.star config/runners.star
fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
replace config/projects/local.star 'base_branch = "main",' 'base_branch = "main", repo = "example/local", forge = "github", vars = {"round": {"base": "main", "owner": "owner", "lane_cap": 1, "fix_rounds": 1, "label": "round", "steps": {"implement": {"runner": "oc"}}}, "mutation_command": ["sh", "mutation.sh"]},'
chmod 755 fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/gh

exec beehestreal item add local 7 --title 'An item' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehestreal run 7 local --workflow flow/workflow.star
stderr 'REFUSE: vars.review_skill of the project file is None'
stderr 'the review skill of the sweep step'
stderr 'step preflight:intake done'
! stderr 'step agent:'
! exists calls.log

-- runners.star --
runner(name = "a", agent = "claude", config_dir = "@WORK@")

runner(name = "oc", agent = "opencode")
-- body.txt --
The item.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- fake/gh --
#!/bin/sh
# The item has no pull request in any state.
echo '[]'
-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
cat > /dev/null
echo agent >> "@WORK@/calls.log"
exit 1
